name: Song Meter BirdNET
tagline: Runs Song Meter cards through local BirdNET and preps Raven tables
description: A field-research workflow for Wildlife Acoustics Song Meter recordings. Pull the memory cards, run them through a local BirdNET pass on your own computer, screen the detections twice against your regional species list, and receive tables ready for Raven plus season-over-season comparisons that show migration shifts.
author: scgerber
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
